answer: Each seat forges a small iron tally per epoch in its own hearth from ore stamped with a mine-lot code, then lodges it in the vault. Slag is weighed too: the slag-to-iron ratio fingerprints one ore lot and furnace, and a single hearth cannot yield two signatures in one epoch, so seats sharing a fire collide and are refused. The cooling basin holds lotus that blooms in step with the water heat, so a forge on double shifts flowers early, exposing overuse before payout clears. Cost per identity: one ore lot, one smith-day, fuel, a locked deposit, linear, while each seat reward stays flat.
